blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with a restrained single-hue accent (#4477AA throughout), intentional typographic hierarchy (muted uppercase panel labels, weighted title, dimmed metadata), and a genuinely clever color-usage panel that uses actual hex values as point fills — elevated above generic, though 9px axis labels and tiny network node text push some elements to the edge of legibility.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt used for both node and color-scatter radii, bar baseline at zero with data-driven domain, scale domains derived from d3.extent/d3.max and fixed at init to prevent axis jumping on filter — only minor concern is color axes hardcoded to HCL space bounds [0,360]/[0,100], which is semantically correct but not strictly data-driven.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces brush storms, pointer events prevent touch fights, and no cross-view dispatch loops exist; the one weakness is that x/y scales are captured in static closures at init with no ResizeObserver, leaving interactions stale after any viewport resize.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four-view crossfilter is within working-memory limits, the network uses a single-hue palette avoiding color overload, and the color scatter is self-encoding (marks are their own color), but the color panel is dense enough that brushing a precise hue/lightness region requires careful aim.
